context: Tests whether the agent triages CI failures the way the ci-detective skill prescribes when the user only asks whether their PR broke CI: cross-referencing each failure against runs on other branches, presenting the comparison table keyed by run id and branch, using the three verdicts including 'unverified' when no other run can be compared, refusing to call a failure flaky or infrastructure without evidence, and tracing introduced and unverified failures to the diff with the four required items.

checklist.name: Comparison table shape
checklist.description: ci-report.md has a table with one row per failing test and columns for the PR's run, one column per reference run headed by its run id and branch (for example 'Run 9000000901 (main)'), and a Verdict column

checklist.name: test_A pre-existing with evidence
checklist.description: test_A is classified as pre-existing, citing the specific other-branch runs where it fails with the same error (9000000901 on main and 9000000851 on develop)

checklist.name: test_B introduced
checklist.description: test_B is classified as introduced by this PR, because it passes in every reference run that ran it

checklist.name: test_C unverified
checklist.description: test_C is classified as unverified (no reference run ran it), not as pre-existing and not as introduced

checklist.name: No flaky or infra assumption
checklist.description: The report does not call test_C (the payment gateway mock timeout) flaky, infrastructure-related or environmental without evidence from other runs; any such hypothesis is labelled unverified

checklist.name: Unverified failure investigated
checklist.description: test_C is still investigated against the diff and error output, as introduced failures are, and the report states that no other run could be compared

checklist.name: test_B root cause
checklist.description: The root cause for test_B is the rename of get_cart_total to compute_cart_total in the diff, which leaves the test calling a method that no longer exists

checklist.name: Four items per failure
checklist.description: For each introduced or unverified failure the report gives the error message, the relevant lines from the diff, a short explanation of the causal link (or why none was found), and a suggested fix

checklist.name: Concrete fix for test_B
checklist.description: A concrete fix is suggested for test_B, such as updating the test to call compute_cart_total or keeping get_cart_total as an alias
